subject: EdgeOps vendor activation — coverage snapshot & subcontractor schedule
messages:
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Cole <erin.cole@edgeops.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Oct 2026 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: EdgeOps vendor activation — coverage snapshot & subcontractor schedule

Hi Erin —

Thanks again for choosing Redwood for the pilot. To get procurement moving towards a conditional PO we need a short set of risk docs from EdgeOps so the activation team can queue your onboarding. Can you please provide the following by EOD next Wednesday (10/07)?

- A current coverage snapshot (cert page or summary) showing limits and effective/expiry dates (primary liability + cyber).
- Subcontractor schedule (names of any downstream vendors that will access Redwood systems or customer data).
- Completed vendor onboarding questionnaire (we can accept a PDF export or a link).
- W9 (if not already on file) — needed to create the PO in our system.

If you can attach the cert and schedule in reply that will speed things up. If there are any endorsement requirements (additional insured or waiver of subrogation), note those in the reply and procurement will confirm next steps.

Next steps from our side: once we have the docs, procurement will flag any conditional PO items and support will schedule a brief security sync if our security team needs clarifications.

Thanks — really excited to get the pilot started.

Jordan Blake
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0198

From: Erin Cole <erin.cole@edgeops.io>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Ben Harris <ben.harris@edgeops.io>, procurement@edgeops.io
Date: Wed, 01 Oct 2026 14:16:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeOps vendor activation — coverage snapshot & subcontractor schedule

Jordan —

Thanks for the clear checklist. Attached are the files we have ready: EdgeOps_Coverage_Snapshot.pdf (cert page summary), Subcontractor_Schedule.csv (names + roles), and EdgeOps_W9.pdf.

A few notes:
- Our primary liability policy is on a blanket basis. The certificate lists the carrier and limits; we can arrange an AI endorsement if Redwood requires it for the pilot.
- Subcontractor list includes two analytics partners (Maple Analytics; data ingestion team) and one SRE subcontractor (North Harbor). All three have data access controls in place — I can share their SOC/attestation docs if needed.
- We completed your vendor questionnaire last quarter; attaching the PDF export to this thread in case procurement wants the form retained in file.

If you need an endorsement or specific language on the certificate, let me know and I will coordinate with our broker.

Best,
Erin Cole
Head of Operations | EdgeOps
erin.cole@edgeops.io

Attachments:
- EdgeOps_Coverage_Snapshot.pdf (application/pdf)
- Subcontractor_Schedule.csv (text/csv)
- EdgeOps_W9.pdf (application/pdf)

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>, Erin Cole <erin.cole@edgeops.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Oct 2026 10:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeOps vendor activation — coverage snapshot & subcontractor schedule

Thanks Erin — I pulled the attachments into procurement. Quick notes after initial review:

- Coverage snapshot: limits meet our baseline for a pilot. We will request an Additional Insured endorsement for the primary commercial general liability only if the pilot involves co-located customer data use cases; otherwise the cert is acceptable for a conditional PO.
- Cyber coverage: appears to be present but note the retroactive date is earlier than our standard — security might request the SOC/attestation for the analytic subcontractor (Maple Analytics).
- Subcontractor schedule: please include a contact (name + email) for each downstream vendor if possible; that helps our risk team triage faster.
- W9 received — thanks.

Can we aim to have final endorsement requests (if any) determined by Tuesday 10/06 so billing can create the PO on 10/07? Jordan — can you confirm the pilot scope so we can decide on the additional insured ask?
Laura Bennett
Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Erin Cole <erin.cole@edgeops.io>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 05 Oct 2026 16:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: EdgeOps vendor activation — coverage snapshot & subcontractor schedule

Erin — quick update following procurement review and internal scope check:

- Pilot scope is limited to sandboxed ingestion and model evaluation using de-identified datasets — no customer PII will be forwarded. Given that, procurement is comfortable proceeding with a conditional PO using the certs you provided (no AI endorsement required for this pilot).
- Security asked for the SOC note for Maple Analytics — if you can share their attestation (PDF or link) that should close the remaining question.
- We will send the conditional PO (net-30) once procurement confirms billing on 10/07. Expect a DocuSign envelope for the SOW next week.

Appreciate the quick turnaround — cc'ing Karthik to coordinate the kickoff timeline after PO issuance.

Thanks,
Jordan
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com
